description: WP1.6 THROWAWAY diff-harness fixture. Validates the old-vs-new byte-identical diff methodology reused in Phase 5 (strangler parity) — it is NOT a committed compensation migration. Canonical output = roundMoney(amount * rate) formatted to exactly 2 decimals, invariant culture. roundMoney = Math.round((x + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100 (packages/api/src/lib/currency.ts). The EPSILON nudge is the interesting cross-language case: without the JS Number.EPSILON constant (2.220446049250313e-16, NOT C# double.Epsilon), 1.005 rounds to 1.00. Both the real TS roundMoney and the C# port must emit byte-identical strings.
